classes.description: MfgOrder — 制造工单。生产特定数量产品的业务指令，定义目标产品(Product)、数量(Qty/Qty2)、工艺路线(Workflow/BillOfProcess)、ERP BOM、物料需求清单(MaterialList)、执行任务历史等完整生产执行配置。工单发放后产生容器(Container)追踪生产进度。 【Swagger】Schema: MfgOrderEntity；来源文件: MfgOrders.json；API: /api/MfgOrders。

properties.name: scheduleType
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleType 【Swagger】Optional value used to indicate the type of schedule required for the order. If a value is not entered any schedule type can be used. Valid values include: i) WAFER ii) WAFERSORT iii) ASSEMBLYCARRIER iv) ASSEMBLYMOTHERLOT v) ASSEMBLYSUBLOT vi) BACKG

properties.name: scheduleQtyCanceled
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleQtyCanceled 【Swagger】Stores the quantity from schedules that were canceled. This value will be updated when a schedule is canceled through LotScheduleCancel.

properties.name: orderCompletionDate
properties.description: 物理字段 OrderCompletionDate 【Swagger】Stores the timestamp when the order is completed.

properties.name: orderStartDate
properties.description: 物理字段 OrderStartDate 【Swagger】Stores the timestamp when a schedule was first created for the Work Order.

properties.name: scheduleQtyCompleted
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleQtyCompleted 【Swagger】Stores the total quantity completed for the Work Order. This value is updated when the schedule completes from WIP to INVENTORY.

properties.name: scheduleQty
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleQty 【Swagger】Stores the total quantity scheduled for the Work Order. This value will be updated when a schedule is created.

properties.name: scheduleCanceled
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleCanceled 【Swagger】Stores the number of schedules that was canceled for the Work Order. This value will be automatically updated when a schedule is canceled.

properties.name: scheduleCompleted
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleCompleted 【Swagger】Stores the number of schedules completed for the Work Order. This value will be automatically updated when a schedule completes successfully.

properties.name: scheduleCount
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleCount 【Swagger】Stores the number of schedules used for the Work Order. This value is automatically updated when a schedule is created for the Work Order.

properties.name: scheduleLimit
properties.description: 物理字段 ScheduleLimit 【Swagger】This field is used to indicate the maximum number of schedules allowed to meet the Work Order. A Work Order is considered completed if the completed quantity meets or exceeds its required quantity. A value of 0 or less means no limits hence the Work Or

properties.name: isCompleted
properties.description: 物理字段 IsCompleted 【Swagger】Flag indicaiting whether the Work Order is completed. This value is updated when the Work Order quantity is met or exceeded or when the ScheduleLimit with value greater than 0 is reached and all schedules are completed.

properties.name: isCanceled
properties.description: 物理字段 IsCanceled 【Swagger】Flag indicating whether the Work Order was canceled. This flag can be updated to cancel the Work Order such that it will not appear during Lot Schedule.

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 设置权限配置 → SetupAccess 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: customerProductCode
properties.description: 物理字段 CustomerProductCode 【Swagger】Customer Product Code

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: WIP消息定义管理器 → WIPMsgDefMgr 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.description: 工单唯一名称（必填） 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance

properties.description: 图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: qty
properties.description: 计划生产数量 【Swagger】Identifies the (final) quantity to be produced to fulfill this Manufacturing Order

properties.name: qty2
properties.description: 辅助数量 【Swagger】Identifies the (final) quantity to be produced to fulfill this Manufacturing Order

properties.name: uom
properties.description: 工单计划数量主单位 → UOM 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: uom2
properties.description: 工单计划数量副单位 → UOM

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: reportingFactory
properties.description: 汇报/所属工厂 → Factory 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: defaultLot
properties.description: 生产容器的默认批次号 【Swagger】If a lot or batch ID have been assigned to this order then it would be listed here. Optionally, this can be the container name when the container is started.

properties.name: orderStatus
properties.description: 工单状态 → OrderStatus 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: externallyControlled
properties.description: 是否由外部系统控制 【Swagger】Indicates that this object is controlled externally from InSite and updates/edits should be controlled or restricted within InSite

properties.name: priority
properties.description: 工单优先级限制 → PriorityCode 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: orderType
properties.description: 工单类型 → OrderType 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: plannedStartDate
properties.description: 计划生产开始日期 【Swagger】Indicates the planned start date for this order

properties.name: plannedCompletionDate
properties.description: 计划生产完成日期 【Swagger】Indicates the planned completion date for this order

properties.name: defaultPutawayStockPoint
properties.description: 默认入库库存点 【Swagger】Indicates the ERP location that the finished assembly should be put away to at the end of WIP.

properties.name: erpbom
properties.description: ERP BOM 引用 → ERPBOM 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: releaseDate
properties.description: 工单发放到生产线的日期 【Swagger】Indicates the date this order was released from the ERP down to InSite

properties.name: preProductionProcedure
properties.description: 前置生产流程 → MfgOrderProcedure 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: postProductionProcedure
properties.description: 后置生产流程 → MfgOrderProcedure 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: preProductionProcedureRequired
properties.description: 指示是否需要预生产程序（0=否，1=是，默认-1），首次Move/MoveIn时更新。 【Swagger】Indicates if a Pre-Production Procedure is required for this order. 0 = No 1 = Yes Default is -1. Processing during the first Move/MoveIn Txn for the a container will query the workflow for any spec with the RequirePreProductionProcedure option set. If any spec has it, the field value is updated to 1, else set to 0.

properties.name: preProductionProcedureState
properties.description: MfgOrderTaskState：1-未开始，2-进行中，3-失败，4-完成。 【Swagger】MfgOrderTaskState 1 - Not Started 2 - In Progress 3 - Failed 4 - Complete

properties.name: postProductionProcedureState
properties.description: MfgOrderTaskState：1-未开始，2-进行中，3-失败，4-完成。 【Swagger】MfgOrderTaskState 1 - Not Started 2 - In Progress 3 - Failed 4 - Complete

properties.description: 初始/开工产品 → Product 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: product
properties.description: 目标产品 → Product 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: erpRoute
properties.description: ERP 工艺路线 → ERPRoute 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: billOfProcess
properties.description: BOP 工艺清单 → BillOfProcess 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

classes.description: MfgOrderMaterialListItem — 制造工单运行时所拥有的物料需求明细记录。当工单下达或发放时，系统根据 BOM 结构解析生成该表中的数据，用于记录运行时工单实际消耗的物料及其工艺绑定、替代关系、数量要求等。
